checks.checks: Explicit nonpayment establishes complimentary; complementary means mutually fitting, comprehensive broad, competitive favorable compared with rivals. Substantive English context added; preserve original ID before new revision.

activeQuestion.prompt: Guests who book directly with the hotel do not have to pay the usual breakfast charge. They receive a ____ breakfast.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 直接向飯店訂房的旅客無須支付一般早餐費，可享用____早餐。

options.whyZh: 與 complimentary 拼字相似，但意思不同。
前一句說這些旅客不必付早餐費，complimentary breakfast 表示飯店免費招待的早餐。
comprehensive 表示內容完整或涵蓋廣泛，並未說明是否免費。
通常形容價格或能力，不表示免費招待。
